name: Nutrient AI Gateway
description: A document-workflow platform with an OpenAI-compatible text gateway.
overview: The free plan includes $5 of usage each month without a card, shared across all Nutrient APIs. Credits reset each billing period and do not roll over. No signup or inference was tested.
